name: Hardware EWA Splatting Pipeline
definition: A hardware architecture designed to complement existing triangle rendering functionality with EWA splats, making maximum reuse of existing GPU units. It renders EWA splats in a single pass using a ternary depth test and extended blending.
summary: The Hardware EWA Splatting Pipeline is a GPU architecture that renders elliptical weighted average splats in a single pass using a surface reconstruction buffer and ternary depth test to defer shading and normalize attributes.
